entities.summary: Milan Brglez is a Slovenian political scientist and politician who served as Speaker of the National Assembly of Slovenia from 2014 to 2018. He served as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) between 2019 and 2024. A member of the Social Democrats, part of the Party of European Socialists, Brglez was a candidate in the 2022 presidential election.
